info.title: Integrations Storefront API
info.description: Storefront-facing integration endpoints under /api/v1/integrations (catalog, cart, checkout/orders, payments, shipping, themes, and storefront helpers). Authenticate with X-Api-Key (sk_test_… / sk_live_…) or Bearer OAuth access token. Set store context via X-Store-Slug (preferred) or X-Store-Id when Host does not resolve a store.

StoreSlug.name: X-Store-Slug
StoreSlug.description: Store slug for tenant context (required for storefront/tenant routes unless Host resolves a store).

StoreId.name: X-Store-Id
StoreId.description: Store publicId (UUID) for tenant context. Prefer X-Store-Slug when possible.
